title: The Wrong Parcel
summary: Mara's courier delivered the wrong bundle. Inside is the page torn from the Warden journal. Ask around about Old Mara.

goals.say: 'Old Mara? She's been old as long as anyone remembers. My grandmother said the same.'
goals.name: Village Elder

quest_book.title: The Torn Page
quest_book.author: Maraal
pages:
Seven Nails I drove, and seven keepers I bound.

Ash: the Wither. Silence: the Dragon. Frost: Skor. Sand: Sirok. Tide: Nerakyss. The Gate: Helvar. The Flame: Ashlord, who was his.

Kill the keepers and the Nails break, and the halves may find each other.

Never let anyone kill them all.
- Maraal, first Preacher of Azriel, who took his head.

threats.name: Village Elder
threats.target_line: 'Old Mara? She's been old as long as anyone remembers. My grandmother said the same.'
talk: How long has Old Mara lived here?
She's been old as long as anyone remembers. My grandmother said the same.
Nobody knows. Her letters just... arrive.
